svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut a 250 mm disc from 18 ga uncoated steel with snips; file the edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut a 106 mm hole in the middle (2.3 mm clear of the 4 in pipe).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill four 3.5 mm holes on a 230 mm circle for sheet metal screws.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the 180 mm hole in the galvanized cap leaves a 39 mm gap round the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: hot outlet. Pack the gap with AES blanket (20 mm deep), then lay the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: ring over it and screw it to the cap at its outer edge.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The ring, not the cap, faces the hot pipe, so no zinc sits within

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 39 mm of it (requirement R13: no zinc above 200 degrees C).

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the ring does not touch the pipe at any point.
